explanation: For I and II, the integrands and their t derivatives are continuous and bounded on [0,1] in a sufficiently small neighborhood of each allowed t, permitting differentiation under the integral sign. For III, the t derivative has a nonintegrable |x−t|^(−3/2) singularity. Although F₃ itself is differentiable, direct differentiation under its integral sign is invalid. Thus I and II only.
